sentences.en: You'll have this composition written by noon tomorrow, won't you?
sentences.zh: 你明天中午之前会把这篇作文写完，对吧？

sentences.en: We had hoped that the rain would stop before noon.
sentences.zh: 我们希望雨在中午前就会停。

sentences.en: Mrs. Jones ordered the room to be swept by noon.
sentences.zh: 琼斯太太吩咐要在中午之前打扫房间。

senses.zh: 正午，中午,全盛期，顶点,〈古〉午夜,晌午
